forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {着替|きが}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to change clothes; to get changed
definitions.explanation: To take off current clothes and put on different ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かいた→掻く：09647_kaku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧たい。
examples.english: I'm sweaty so I want to change clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ったら→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧、⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧な⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着替|きが}える。
examples.english: When I get home from work, I immediately change into comfortable clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧させて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I got the child changed before going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧て⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I change into my uniform before going to school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{更衣室|こういしつ}→更衣室：07042_kouishitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧て、⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I changed in the locker room and got in the pool.

notes:
{着替|きが}える is both transitive and intransitive. It can mean "to change one's own clothes" (intransitive use) or "to change [specific clothing]" (transitive use).

ASPECT (ている):
⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ typically indicates an ongoing action of changing clothes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着替|きが}える - to change into clothes
- ⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧させる - to change someone's clothes (causative)
- ⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧ - change of clothes (noun form)
- [clothing]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{着替|きが}える - to change into [clothing]
- [clothing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{着替|きが}える - to change [specific clothing item]

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{着替|きが}え→着替え：16045_kigae⟧: spare clothes, change of clothes
- ⟦{更衣室|こういしつ}→更衣室：07042_kouishitsu⟧: changing room, locker room
